The backend exposes REST endpoints via backend/src/api/health.py and backend/src/api/apple_music.py which route to services in backend/src/services/spotify_client.py and backend/src/services/apple_music_client.py. Mobile clients in Mobile App connect to these APIs through backend/src/middleware/auth.py for token validation. The configuration layer in Configuration manages environment variables via Pydantic settings, while Data Persistence uses Firebase Firestore for DJ set storage.
